_: AD-25. Get involved — /act. THE PAGE EIGHTEEN OTHER PAGES ALREADY POINT AT. The frozen homepage's band 12 is called 'Three ways in' and its three buttons — 'Give monthly', 'See the dates', 'Work with us' — have pointed at href="#" since 19 August. The Give chip in every nav on this site says /act. Eighteen WORK items AND all four kind landings end in a named ask whose href is /act ('Bring your school', 'Plant with us', 'Apply for a fellowship', …) — twenty-two asks, which the build counts rather than this file asserting. And /act served a sixty-line Tailwind placeholder whose own copy said the sign-up 'isn't connected yet'. That is the AD-24 lesson for the third time: a nav word, a built file and a route, and any two of them without the third is a defect. THE SPINE IS THE HOMEPAGE'S OWN THREE, IN THE HOMEPAGE'S OWN ORDER — Give, Volunteer, Partner — because the door and the room must not disagree. RULINGS APPLIED, all three given by the owner on 22 August: G-1 the Give ask ROUTES TO A HUMAN; there is no payment destination anywhere in this repository and none is invented, so the band states the ask, names the hole, and ends in an email. G-2 Volunteer ASKS TO BE TOLD rather than faking a calendar; all four event formats carry named holes saying we cannot say when the last one ran, so this page will not say when the next one is. G-3 the ₹500 figure is CARRIED FROM THE FROZEN HOMEPAGE AND FLAGGED IN THE LEDGER as design copy awaiting the owner's confirmation — it is not promoted to a sourced fact, and the build asserts it still matches home.html so the two cannot drift. F-2's precedent from /farm governs the ending: a phone number and an email, not a form. NOTHING IN THIS FILE IS AN ASK LIST — the eighteen asks are NOT typed here. They are read out of data/work/*/*.json by the build and grouped into the three ways, so a nineteenth ask cannot be added to the WORK section and left unanswered here; the build dies on a label no way claims. Same architecture as /impact's figures and /farm's two resolved ones, applied to inbound asks.
_channels: THE CHANNEL SLOTS. On 22 August the owner asked about Google Forms. A form is a real destination - it receives a submission - so it is strictly better than a mailto: for Volunteer. It cannot help Give: a form does not take money, and the build refuses `give.form` for that reason (/act now carries the two bank accounts instead, which is the destination G-1 actually wanted). ★ THE FORM EXISTS AS OF 16 SEPTEMBER 2026 and it is ONE form, not three, per AD-25 §7: a person who wants to volunteer AND bring their school should not fill two, and three response sheets is three inboxes nobody checks. Its first question routes to six sections. ★ NOBODY MAY INVENT THESE URLS. A guessed form URL is a 404 behind a live-looking button, which is the exact defect this page was built to fix, so the build rejects anything that is not a docs.google.com/forms URL.

funds.p: The longest thing Swechha runs is twelve days downstream, and the schools that most need to walk it are the ones with no line in the budget for it.
A garden is cheap to plant and expensive to keep. The second year is the one nobody funds and the only one that proves anything.

funds.p: A room full of paper, going back to the first year on the river. Cataloguing and scanning it is slow work that no grant covers.

There is no payment page behind the button…' plus an `unlocks` line naming the gateway/UPI/bank details we would need. RULING G-1 IS UNCHANGED AND STILL ENFORCED — there is no payment destination in this repository, none is invented, and the Give button opens an email to a person rather than faking a card form. What is deleted is the PARAGRAPH EXPLAINING THAT to the visitor. The button says what it does; a reader who clicks it gets a person. AD-28 §2.3: show less, do not explain the absence.

payment._: THE PAYMENT DESTINATION. Ruling G-1 said there was none in this repository, that none would be invented, and that the Give button would open an email to a person rather than fake a card form. The owner supplied these accounts on 15 September 2026 and G-1 is closed by the only thing that could close it: a real destination. The mailto stays beside them, because a RECURRING gift needs a standing instruction a web page cannot set up. NOTHING HERE IS TYPED INTO THE GENERATOR. Every digit is read from this file, and the PAN is not here at all - it is read from data/ledger.json, which already holds it, because two copies of a registration number is how one of them goes stale.
payment._fcra: THE TWO ACCOUNTS ARE NOT INTERCHANGEABLE AND THE PAGE MAY NEVER LET THEM READ AS IF THEY WERE. Under the Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Act a foreign contribution may be received ONLY in the designated FCRA account, and that account may receive nothing else - not a rupee of domestic money. Sending the wrong money to the wrong one of these is the donor's mistake and the organisation's problem. So each account carries its own eligibility sentence, and a gate below refuses the page if either account number renders without one.

accounts.label: From outside India
accounts.who: A foreign contribution, as the FCRA defines one. This account may receive nothing else.
accounts.name: Swechha We for Change Foundation
accounts.branch: New Delhi Main Branch, 11 Sansad Marg, New Delhi 110001
accounts._branch: NOT AN ARBITRARY BRANCH. The FCRA (Amendment) Act 2020 requires every recipient to hold its FCRA account at this one branch of the State Bank of India. It is a fact about the law, not a preference, which is why it is spelled out.

payment.head: Where the money goes in
payment.lead: Two accounts, and which one you use is decided by where your money is coming from.
payment.note: Send us your name, address and PAN when you transfer — without them a donation cannot be reported and no 80G certificate can be issued for it.
payment._note: ★ THIS IS NOT A COURTESY, IT IS RULE 18AB. The 80G certificate is Form 10BE, and Swechha can only issue one for a donation it has reported in Form 10BD — which requires the donor's name, address and PAN. A bare bank transfer carries none of those. So the one thing this page has to ask of a donor who uses the accounts above is the thing the form needs, and saying 'ask for a receipt' instead would have been a polite way of losing them the deduction.

partner.head:
Bring us a ward,
a river stretch
or a cohort
partner.lead: Schools, companies and researchers. A partnership here is a piece of ground, a cohort of people or a stretch of river that somebody else is accountable for — not a logo on a banner.

doors.name: Schools
doors.p: The oldest door and the widest. A year-long curriculum, a journey for one cohort, or a single day on the farm. Delhi schools run this every year and have for fifteen.

doors.name: Companies
doors.p: Five companies have paid for planting seasons. What that buys is saplings that are still alive three years later, which costs more than the planting day and photographs worse.

doors.name: Organisations and researchers
doors.p: Seventy-five organisations take Swechha's volunteers, and that half of the arrangement is the one most easily forgotten. Bring a question, a ward or a river stretch and there is usually a way in.

standing.head:
What you would
be giving to
standing.lead: Giving money to an organisation is the one moment its registration number matters more than its name.

rows.p: The registered name. Everywhere else the organisation is Swechha. The long one belongs to the registrar.
The office. The farm is ninety minutes out at Ladpuri and has its own page.
Twenty-six years on the river, in schools, and on the land.
Indian tax registration, renewed 28 January 2026. A gift is deductible under section 80G; the order numbers and the years they cover are on the ledger.
Renewed 27 June 2024 and valid to 30 June 2029. A foreign contribution may be received only in the FCRA account below.

standing._rows: ★ THE 'A GIFT IS DEDUCTIBLE' SENTENCE HAS NOW BEEN TRUE, THEN FALSE, THEN TRUE AGAIN, and the row followed the documents each time rather than the other way round. It was struck on 15 September 2026 because both Form 10AC orders had expired with assessment year 2026-27 and the page was about to print a bank account. The Form 10AD renewals of 28 January 2026 arrived the next day, covering assessment year 2027-28 onward, so it is back. The row also says 12AB rather than 12A: the renewal is granted under section 12AB(1)(b), which is the section that replaced it. 'FCRA held' became the number when its certificate arrived. See data/ledger.json's `_80g` note.

This supersedes the phone half of ruling F-2 — that page still ends in a human rather than a form, which was F-2's point, but the human is reached by email. DO NOT RE-ADD A PERSONAL NUMBER. A gate in build-act-page.mjs fails the build if the struck number reappears anywhere in the output, because a struck fact getting re-imported by a later session acting in good faith is the failure mode this repository keeps hitting. An office landline is a different question and needs the owner to say so.
